statement: Adult African spiny mice (Acomys) regenerate full-thickness dorsal skin wounds and ear punches with hair follicles, sebaceous glands, dermis and cartilage, where laboratory mice heal the same wounds by fibrotic scar.

context.model: skin autotomy wounds; 4 mm ear punch

measurement.endpoint: appendage and dermal regeneration in the wound
measurement.effect: complete regeneration of follicles, glands, dermis and cartilage in ear punches; hair follicle regeneration in dorsal wounds

evidence.note: ear-hole closure as a discrete trait across species

replication.note: The four sources share authorship (Seifert, Maden, Brant). Independent replication is the Matias Santos claim below, which is why this claim's replication count is 1 and not 4.

limitations: a rodent, so L2 by the ladder even though the finding is a species trait rather than an intervention
mechanism not established by these papers

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (PubMed) and Crossref metadata, checked 2026-09-11; no source opened at figure level
